use_case: Face verification (1:1) at employee entrances of 3 Florida county government centers: the reader checks that a live face matches the enrolled template of the badge presented
business_owner: Facilities Support security systems director (for the counties, which decide on use)
vendor_or_model: Access control SaaS vendor face verification module (machine learning face matching) with face-capable readers
build_or_buy: Buy (vendor feature, configured by the group)
data_categories: Face templates; enrollment photos; badge IDs; match scores; access events
human_in_the_loop: Face match is a second factor with the badge. A failed match falls back to badge plus PIN or the guard desk; no one is refused entry on a face result alone
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171 and 501.702 (Florida worked example; whether templates are biometric data is unsettled, so they are handled as such); Fla. Stat. 119.0701 (contractor public records); FTC Act Section 5 (claims); county contract terms; Colorado SB26-189 if ever used in Colorado (essential government services or employment)
status: In production for enrolled volunteers with conditions due 2026-12-31; no new sites or enrollments until the conditions are met

use_case: Face identification (1:N) of people in public lobbies against a watch list (requested by a county and a commercial monitoring customer)
data_categories: Face images of members of the public; watch lists
affects_individuals: Yes (members of the public visiting government offices and a commercial building)
human_in_the_loop: Proposed: alerts to guards; no review or appeal design
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 501.171 and 501.702 (Florida worked example); FTC Act Section 5; customer counsel review required
status: Not approved. The Group AI council declined it (P01 JS-014, Avoid)
division: Government Facilities Support; Janitorial and Security

use_case: Video analytics in the central monitoring station that flag people and vehicles in camera views and rank alarms for operators (no face recognition)
vendor_or_model: Video analytics vendor models running on the video SaaS
data_categories: Live and recorded video; alarm events
affects_individuals: Yes (people in camera views at 640 sites)
human_in_the_loop: Operators review every flagged event before dispatch or police notification; analytics never dispatch on their own
applicable_laws: Monitoring contract terms; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims); state video and privacy laws (generic); Texas TRAIGA (ROC-2 is in Texas; intent-based prohibitions only)
status: In production at 640 sites; per-site detection testing due 2027-03-31

use_case: Building automation fault detection and HVAC optimization: advisory recommendations at 120 sites; closed-loop setpoint writes in a pilot at 6 county sites
vendor_or_model: Building analytics vendor platform connected to the IBOP supervisory servers
data_categories: Trend data; setpoints; schedules; occupancy counts (no personal data)
human_in_the_loop: Advisory mode: engineers approve every change. Pilot: writes only within controller hard limits set by the group, with a rollback switch at the ROC
applicable_laws: County contract terms; NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3 (OT guidance)
status: Advisory in production; closed-loop pilot limited to 6 sites until the conditions are met; no expansion before 2027-03-31

use_case: Applicant screening and interview scheduling: ranks applications against job requirements and schedules interviews (about 70,000 applications a year)
human_in_the_loop: Recruiters review every application the tool ranks low before rejection; no automatic rejection
applicable_laws: Colorado SB26-189 (deployer duties for Colorado applicants from 2027-01-01); Title VII (42 U.S.C. 2000e-2(k)); 29 CFR 1607.4(D) (four-fifths rule as a test benchmark); NYC Local Law 144 not applicable (no NYC hiring)

use_case: Construction estimating and quantity takeoff assistant that reads drawings and produces quantities
vendor_or_model: Cloud AI estimating service (commercial; not FedRAMP Moderate equivalent)
data_categories: Drawings and specifications, including CUI drawings uploaded before 2026-09-01
human_in_the_loop: Estimators check every quantity before a bid
status: CUI uploads blocked since 2026-09-01; non-CUI use approved; deletion confirmation and an alternative inside SYS-C2 due 2026-12-31

use_case: Generative drafting of security officer incident reports from officer notes and voice dictation on the guard tour app
vendor_or_model: Hosted large language model inside the guard tour app (vendor, no-training terms)
data_categories: Officer notes; dictation; names and descriptions of people involved in incidents
consequential_decision_category: None directly; reports may be used by customers, police, and courts
human_in_the_loop: Officer reviews, edits, and attests every report; supervisors sample 5% weekly
applicable_laws: Customer contract terms; Fla. Stat. 119.0701 (reports for public customers may be public records); state recording consent laws for dictation of others (Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example)
status: In production with conditions (attestation and sampling) due 2026-12-31

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant (drafting and summarizing internal documents)
vendor_or_model: Enterprise AI assistant tenant with no-training terms
data_categories: Internal documents; Restricted data (CUI, consumer reports, security layouts) prohibited
human_in_the_loop: Users review outputs; prohibited for decisions about people
status: Pilot for 3,000 users; CUI and Restricted labels blocked

use_case: Meeting transcription and summaries for internal meetings
vendor_or_model: Transcription feature of the enterprise collaboration suite
human_in_the_loop: Organizer reviews summaries; recording starts only after all-party notice
applicable_laws: State recording consent laws (Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example: all-party consent); POL-05 4.7
